params.body:
## Why

The editorial team works in the Studio, and its Trends tab already had "Looks right" and "Take off". The check of a trend (#508) took nearly the same decision in the Observatory. Two places for one decision leaves nobody sure who approved what, so the check moves to the Studio (Trendwolves/gentells-studio, `workbench/check-in-studio`) and the two become one move.

## What

- `insight-check.mjs`: `checkLines(db, ids)` says where each of a list of trends stands with the check (state, by, at, changed) in one pass. It returns null before the check started.
- `siteTrendsOverview` sends `checkStarted` and, per trend on the site, its `check`. Once the check started, a person standing behind a trend is its look: `looked` comes from the check, and a look from before the check still counts.

## Tests

`trend-desk.test.mjs`: nothing before the start; carried and checked trends with who and whether the text changed since; a declined trend is not in the list. Suite 1853 of 1853, tsc clean.

## Order

Merge before the Studio PR. Nothing changes until the check is started on the box (`node bin/insight-checks.mjs --start --by=<name>`).
params.title: The Studio's trend list says where each trend stands with the check
